set.body:
Scope: ../neurosurf4s; neuro-specific modules/surface, IO, image/transform adapters and fixtures.

Deliverable: Bootstrap an independent build over mesh4s and shared providers; move anatomical metadata, reference surfaces, GIFTI/FreeSurfer policy, projection/resampling and their evidence.

Acceptance:
- Standalone neuro-surface ingestion/projection tests pass on JVM/JS where portable, with platform IO isolated.
- No ScalaFIM dependency or duplicate mesh/frame/domain implementation remains.
- Field order, medial-wall/template policy, reference routes and transform-once semantics survive existing fixtures; necessary test support is owned outside ScalaFIM.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U5: Extract neuro-surface semantics, IO and projection
